items.exampleEn: Her mastery of three languages helped her find a job abroad.
items.exampleZh: 她精通三種語言，這幫助她在國外找到工作。

items.exampleEn: The tired runner staggered across the finish line.
items.exampleZh: 那位疲憊的跑者搖搖晃晃地衝過終點線。

items.exampleEn: My recollection of that day is not very clear.
items.exampleZh: 我對那天的記憶不是很清楚。

items.exampleEn: The old man answered with a smile and a wink.
items.exampleZh: 那位老先生笑著眨了眨眼回應。

items.exampleEn: Fallen leaves slowly decay and turn into soil.
items.exampleZh: 落葉會慢慢腐爛，變成泥土。

items.exampleEn: Puzzles give the mind some stimulation on rainy days.
items.exampleZh: 下雨天時，拼圖能給頭腦一些刺激。

items.exampleEn: She adorned her hair with small white flowers.
With a flutter of its wings, the butterfly landed on my hand.
items.exampleZh: 蝴蝶拍了拍翅膀，停在我的手上。
items.glossZh: 拍動；飄動；（心裡）一陣激動

items.sentenceEn: Colorful lights adorned the streets during the festival.
items.sentenceZh: 節慶期間，五彩繽紛的燈飾點綴著街道。

items.audioEn: I have no recollection of that trip because I was only two years old.
items.audioZh: 我對那趟旅行完全沒有印象，因為我那時才兩歲。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼不記得那趟旅行？

items.sentenceEn: Without care, the old wooden house began to decay.
items.sentenceZh: 沒人照顧，那棟老木屋開始腐朽。

items.sentenceEn: I felt a flutter of excitement before my first concert.
items.sentenceZh: 第一次音樂會前，我心裡一陣激動。

items.stemEn: He gave me a ____ to let me know the surprise party was a secret.
items.stemZh: 他對我眨眨眼，讓我知道驚喜派對是祕密。

items.stemEn: After years of practice, he has achieved complete ____ of the piano.
items.stemZh: 經過多年練習，他已經完全精通鋼琴。

items.passageEn: My earliest recollection is of my grandmother's cottage in the countryside. Painted plates adorned the kitchen walls, and every morning I woke to the flutter of birds' wings outside my window. After she moved to the city, the cottage was left empty, and slowly it began to decay. Last year, my parents bought it back and repaired the roof. When I visited, the smell of the old kitchen brought back so many memories that I felt like a child again.
items.passageZh: 我最早的回憶是祖母在鄉下的小屋。彩繪的盤子裝飾著廚房的牆，每天早上我都在窗外鳥兒拍翅的聲音中醒來。祖母搬到城裡後，小屋就空了下來，漸漸變得破敗。去年，我爸媽把它買回來，修好了屋頂。我去的時候，舊廚房的氣味勾起好多回憶，讓我覺得自己又變回了孩子。

questions.questionZh: 祖母搬走後，小屋怎麼了？
options: 租給了外地來的一家人

questions.questionZh: 去年作者的爸媽做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 這座城市充滿各種刺激：燈光、噪音和人群。
referenceEn: The city is full of stimulation: lights, noise and crowds.
There is so much stimulation in this city, like lights, noise and crowds.
rubricZh: 要用 stimulation 當名詞（例如 full of stimulation）
列舉的寫法例如冒號、like 等都可以

items.instructionZh: 用 stagger 造一個句子，描述你走路搖搖晃晃的一次經驗。
referenceEn: After spinning around ten times, I staggered across the room.
When I first learned to skate, I staggered on the ice.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 stagger（例如 staggered across the room、staggered on the ice 等）
時態配合內容（例如 staggered、stagger 等）
